t: The Nebo Blueline Flex Rechargeable LED Handheld Torch delivers high-intensity lighting for demanding trade environments. Producing up to 600lm with a 179m beam, this durable aluminium torch features various light modes, 5x adjustable zoom, and Flex-Power Technology. Built for site and outdoor use, it is IPX7 water-resistant, drop impact-resistant, and equipped with a USB-C charging port. Designed for reliability and versatility across all working conditions. Run time varies depending on selected light mode: Turbo (600lm for 40 seconds before returning to previous light mode to protect battery), High (350lm for 2 hours), and Low (140lm for 4 hours). Features Flex-Power Technology but can also operate on 1 x AA battery.
